name: Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited
summary: Bright Smart Securities & Commodities Group Limited, set up in 1995 and based in Central, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company owned by New Charming Holdings Limited. It reports securities broking, commodities and futures broking, and bullion trading, offering brokerage in stocks, futures and options, IPO brokerage and funding, margin loans and foreign exchange. It also manages assets and produces financial programs.
